rls_policies: select-own + admin-all on all 13 tables; anon revoked from all; authenticated granted select via ownership chain
decisions: Subjects table is the longitudinal parent; channels are children; accounts table preserved with ownership_status column intact
Living Brief versions are immutable with confirmed flag — model proposals have confirmed=false
Intelligence runs pin subject_id, brief_version, evidence_snapshot_id, methodology_version, expertise_pack_version, prompt_version, model_config_hash, and output_schema_version
Evidence has unique (subject_id, content_hash) for idempotent upsert with snapshot_id grouping
Scores support null value for Data-needed dimensions per contract
Audit batches use (user_id, idempotency_key) unique constraint for atomic idempotency
All 15 RPCs are SECURITY DEFINER, service_role-only, with revoked public/anon/authenticated execute
RLS policed through owns_subject() helper (SECURITY DEFINER) to avoid recursion
context_update_proposals follow the JSON contract: path, operation (add/replace/remove), status (proposed/accepted/rejected/superseded)
Backfill strategy documented in migration comments — existing accounts with ownership_status may be promoted later via future RPC
risks: The fk_intelligence_runs_evidence_snapshot constraint uses ON DELETE RESTRICT — deleting an evidence_snapshot will fail if referenced by an intelligence_run. This matches the contract requirement that run evidence is immutable.
The subject_channels.account_id FK to accounts is nullable and ON DELETE SET NULL — if an account is deleted, the channel remains but loses the backlink. Acceptable for additive migration.
The integration tests require an existing auth.users row for the test user. In CI, a seed step must create this user before running integration tests.
remaining_work: Backfill RPC to promote existing connected/managed accounts into subjects and channels

pgTAP-compatible test suite for CI integration
